facts.fact: SENUM, the state company, announced on 13 November 2026 that the Alibaba Cloud Apsara Stack infrastructure in its Diamniadio data centre will become a national cloud platform after the Dakar 2026 Games, for sovereign hosting of government applications under the New Deal Technologique.

SEN.note: Hosting for the Games' organising committee and a future national cloud; no ministry systems run by SENUM stated.
